notes.title: Apology Statement Regarding the Recent "Game Account Suspension Notice" Announce
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Regarding the recent announcement about the Game Account Suspension Notice, we apologize deeply for the premature decision made without thorough consideration and understanding of the Steam gameplay model. We are truly sorry for this oversight and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

After careful discussion, we have decided that normal players will not be affected. We will use a comprehensive approach to determine if an account is suspicious based on login IP addresses, time intervals, regions, holidays, and the number of connected devices. Currently, we have not banned any accounts and earnestly request your forgiveness.

As this is our first time releasing a game on Steam, we acknowledge there may have been shortcomings in our approach. We are open to feedback and committed to making immediate corrections. Furthermore, since most of our interactive game consists of film and television material, it fundamentally differs from other AAA titles in structure and playable duration. We hope for your continued support of the official release to protect original content.

notes.title: Game Account Ban Explanation
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have noticed that some players have recently been downloading offline versions of the game through certain platforms or logging into the game using shared Steam accounts. In order to protect the interests of all players who have purchased the game and to create a fair gaming environment, we hereby issue this notice: Please refrain from continuing to use such unauthorized methods. If we detect an account logged in on more than two devices, we will proceed to ban that account.
